include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle

# whoami.exe is all Rust (whoami-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/whoami-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# whoami.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/whoami-rust/src/whoami/whoami.rs)
add_cargo_module(whoami whoami-cargo whoami.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE whoami-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS xdk psdk)
